description: Host-provided context for an external verification / KBA / payment signing field (Signing redesign phase 6, SI2). The runner resolves it from TmSigningFormRunner.StepContextProvider on every render and feeds the external step: the provider link, the inline KBA questions, the provider's loading state and error, and the provider's display name. The CONTEXT NEVER CONFIRMS the step — only a stored provider result (value true in Values) does.
